description: Experience seamless language transcription with Vibe - your all-in-one solution for effortless audio and video transcription.
download-starting-description: The download will begin shortly. You can then find the installer in your Downloads folder.
support-while-you-wait: While you wait, consider supporting the Vibe project to help us grow!
title: Transcribe. on Your Own.
highlight-private-description: Transcription runs on your own machine. Audio never leaves your device, online or offline.
highlight-languages-description: Close to 100 languages and a full range of Whisper models, from tiny to large.
highlight-batch-description: Queue whole folders, export SRT, VTT, TXT, HTML or JSON, and drive it from the API.
closing-band-title: Free, open source, and yours to run.
post-download-step-open-installer: Open the installer from your Downloads folder.
post-download-step-launch: Launch Vibe and drop in an audio or video file.
feature-formats-description: Export transcriptions in your preferred format including SRT, VTT, TXT, HTML and many more
feature-url-description: Easily transcribe videos from popular websites like YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and more by simply pasting the URL.
feature-realtime-description: Watch your transcription happen in real-time, with the option to cancel at any moment.
feature-summarize-description: Effortlessly summarize your transcriptions using the Claude API.
feature-ollama-description: Do local AI analysis and batch summaries with Ollama
feature-audio-video-description: Supports audio and video formats like MP4, MKV, MP3, WAV (there's more)
feature-devices-description: Effortlessly convert spoken words to text directly from your microphone or speakers.
feature-gpu-description: Vibe is optimized to run on Nvidia/AMD/Apple GPUs!
feature-privacy-description: Enjoy fully offline transcription, ensuring no data ever leaves your device.
feature-customize-description: Customize models effortlessly in settings for a tailored experience.
